name: Egg freezing (fertility)
summary: How foreign women explore elective egg freezing in Singapore — eligibility rules, clinic pathways, stimulation timelines, and insurance/cash realities for expats.
body:
Elective egg freezing sits under Singapore’s regulated fertility framework. Eligibility, marital-status rules, and what clinics can offer change over time — verify current MOH guidance before booking packages marketed online.

## Decision points
- Elective vs medical fertility preservation pathways
- Ovarian reserve testing (AMH, AFC) before stimulation
- Stimulation calendar vs work-pass travel
- Storage duration, transfer of frozen eggs, and exit logistics
- Cash vs any corporate fertility benefits

Partner and visa timing often matter as much as lab protocol.

## How to choose
Prefer clinics that explain legal eligibility clearly and put storage fees in writing. Ask about after-hours nurse contacts during stimulation. Confirm what happens to stored eggs if you leave Singapore.

## Practical tip
Put injection teaching and blood-test mornings on your calendar before accepting a start date. Missed monitoring windows waste a cycle.
